verdict.rationale: WorkOS ships an official MCP server that lets MCP-compatible AI agents 'read and change the same dashboard data you can (managing organizations, connections, users, branding, and more)' via natural-language-driven agent calls, and a live probe confirms the mcp.workos.com endpoint exists and gates sessions behind OAuth as documented. This covers admin/dashboard operations via an AI agent but is not evidence of natural-language control over WorkOS's core auth/identity APIs beyond that MCP surface. Missing for 10: hands-on transcript/demo of actual natural-language agent sessions, independent (non-vendor) corroboration of MCP usage, and broader coverage of natural-language control beyond dashboard management.
